title: Tower Legends now has a website, with a playable preview!
author: Traditional_End_743
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I just started a website for **Tower Legends**, my tower defense game.

You can check out trailers, explore the different towers and their skill trees, and even **play a small preview of the game directly in your browser**, without downloading anything.

Please check it out. And if you like what you see, Tower Legends is already available on Steam, with a free demo :)

**Website:** [https://tower-legends.pdm.ovh/](https://tower-legends.pdm.ovh/)

**Steam Page:** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012660/Tower\_Legends/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012660/Tower_Legends/)

Saradoc
